MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Songs From The Silver Screen feels like a natural next choice because orchestral vocals connect my enjoyment of Stages and the Downton Abbey soundtrack with my current interest in relaxing listening.",
    "Partners and Emerald: Musical Gems Deluxe appeal to the expressive voices, polished ensemble singing, and gentle arrangements I enjoyed in A Musical Affair and Lead With Your Heart."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "That's Christmas To Me and Christmas connect to something I have enjoyed before, but seasonal music does not suit the everyday listening I want now.",
    "Adele 21 does not offer the orchestral or classical crossover sound I want today. Blake Shelton connects to my country listening, but I would still pass in favor of gentler vocals.",
    "The Very Best Of, Awakening, and The Gift leave me unsure what I would hear; their titles alone do not establish a connection to my musical interests."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to have been taken as an ongoing desire for more holiday albums.",
    "My interest in vocal music seems to have been extended too broadly, although the arrangements and style of singing matter more to me than simply having a prominent singer."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest choice of relaxing classical music matters because I am currently looking for calm music I can enjoy in ordinary daily listening.",
    "My soundtrack and Stages listening points toward expressive vocals supported by orchestral arrangements, which makes film songs especially appealing.",
    "Country remains a plausible interest, but it is less compelling today than gentle ensemble or classical crossover vocals."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in expressive vocal music but gave too much weight to past holiday listening and too little to my current preference for gentle, orchestral everyday listening."
}
